interaction: Drag the gross-mass slider (or pick axles, trailer or a class plate) and a parametric SVG truck morphs from a van through MR and HR rigids to a prime mover with a semi-trailer and a B-double, while the matching LR/MR/HR/HC/MC plate lights up with a plain-English, general-information description; plus a tick-box pre-start checklist that drives a pressure gauge.
notes: Licence descriptions are simplified general information; the mass thresholds used to switch vehicle types are illustrative.
